g.text: ShardPilot: Gradle first, Maven later from the same tag
Push a new immutable release tag
Select the same existing tag with --ref
Check out its exact commit SHA
Resume by ID without Maven upload
Each run executes all 12 checks for the tag's SHA.
The artifact audit checks an already published version.
It does not certify unpublished candidate registry bytes.
Manual Maven runs skip the Gradle publisher.
Central recovery uses the accepted deployment ID.
Never upload an accepted bundle again.
